tooltip.createaerocomputers.hud_helmet_s: Equip to see the rendered hud the linked Board Computer generates.
tooltip.createaerocomputers.hud_display_: Click it to set the linked Board Computer. When set it will render the hud the linked Board Computer generates
tooltip.createaerocomputers.board_comput: This Computer can be program with a language similar to Python, you can read Contraption telemetry data, you can create custom Heads up displays(HUD), you can connect to redstone links to control your aircraft, or if you want more destruction you can link the Create Arms mod for weapon support. If you need help with programming just click the Question Mark Button or Control-Click a word. You will also get feedback if your Syntax is wrong
tooltip.createaerocomputers.weapon_linke: can be placed on an MDF or ... or an Big Cannon Mound, can be linked to a board computer, to get access to the Weapons
tooltip.createaerocomputers.sensor_shift: Place on a Sublevel to get information and telemetry
tooltip.createaerocomputers.digital_tran: Can control the rotation Speed via teh Board computer
tooltip.createaerocomputers.camera_shift: Create an eye for your computer
tooltip.createaerocomputers.radar_blocke: Blocks Radar functions, so you sublevel don't show up
tooltip.createaerocomputers.wireless_key: You can link every key you want with a redstone link frequency
tooltip.createaerocomputers.player_senso: You can read information about th player
tooltip.createaerocomputers.joystick_shi: Use the Joystick with you mouse to get redstone link signals
tooltip.createaerocomputers.paint_table_: Use the Paint Table to draw textures to render in the hud
tooltip.createaerocomputers.thruster_shi: Use it to generate thrust for your aircraft
tooltip.createaerocomputers.projector_sh: Render a 3d hologram into your world
help.aero.basics.text: This is the basics of the Aero Computer.
help.aero.variables.text: Variables store values that your program can use.
help.aero.channels.text: Channels allow your computer to communicate with external devices.
